rules.title: How the pool works
rules.intro: Predict the score of every World Cup match and pick the tournament's champion and top scorer. The more accurate your predictions, the more points you earn — and whoever has the most points at the end wins the pool.
rules.howToPlayBody: For each match, enter the final score you expect. You can change a prediction any time until that match locks. Before the tournament starts, also pick who you think will be the champion and the top scorer.
rules.matchCorrectResult: Correct result — you got the winner right, or correctly called a draw: {points} points.
rules.matchExactScore: Exact score — you got both teams' goals exactly right: {points} points.
rules.regulationNote: Only the regulation 90-minute result counts. Extra time and penalty shootouts are ignored for scoring.
rules.example1: You predict 2–1 and the match ends 2–1 → {points} points (exact score).
rules.example2: You predict 3–0 and the match ends 1–0 → {points} points (correct result, but not the exact score).
rules.example3: You predict 0–2 and the match ends 1–1 → 0 points (wrong result).
rules.topScorerRule: Correctly predicting the top scorer: {points} points.
rules.locksBody: Each match prediction locks 5 minutes before kickoff — after that it can't be changed. Champion and top-scorer picks lock when registration closes, before the tournament begins.
rules.tiebreakBody: If two players have the same total points, the tie is broken by most exact-score hits, then by most correct results.
rules.potBody: Each player pays an entry fee of {fee}. The total pot is the entry fee times the number of players. The app only tracks predictions and payment confirmations — it never handles money.
rules.privacyBody: You can see other players' predictions for a match only after it locks — never before, so nobody can copy picks.
